title: "Albums"

Select a Queen album from the dropdown below to view its cover:

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof album = Inputs.select(
  new Map([
    ["Queen (1973)", "data/1973_queen.jpg"],
    ["Queen II (1974)", "data/1974_queen_ii.jpg"],
    ["Sheer Heart Attack (1974)", "data/1974_sheer_heart_attack.jpg"],
    ["A Night at the Opera (1975)", "data/1975_a_night_at_the_opera.jpg"],
    ["A Day at the Races (1976)", "data/1976_a_day_at_the_races.jpg"],
    ["News of the World (1977)", "data/1977_news_of_the_world.jpg"],
    ["Jazz (1978)", "data/1978_jazz.jpg"],
    ["The Game (1980)", "data/1980_the_game.jpg"],
    ["Flash Gordon (1980)", "data/1980_flash_gordon.jpg"],
    ["Hot Space (1982)", "data/1982_hot_space.jpg"],
    ["The Works (1984)", "data/1984_the_works.jpg"],
    ["A Kind of Magic (1986)", "data/1986_a_kind_of_magic.jpg"],
    ["The Miracle (1989)", "data/1989_the_miracle.jpg"],
    ["Innuendo (1991)", "data/1991_innuendo.jpg"],
    ["Made in Heaven (1995)", "data/1995_made_in_heaven.jpg"]
  ]),
  { label: "Album:" }
)

html`<div style="margin-top: 1rem;"><img src="${album}" alt="Album cover" style="max-width: 400px; width: 100%; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);"></div>`
```
